methodology.how: ONE FUNCTION, main() (:69-168), no CLI arguments, one environment variable. (1) load_routing() (:31-53) reads the manifest's `threads` list and lifts 14 fields per row, family == thread_id by CVO's convention (:74). (2) load_census_detail() (:56-66) indexes pass1_inventory.json allThreads by thread_id, then OVERLAYS pass2_gapfamilies.json threads (setdefault family) -- a thread present in both takes pass2's row. (3) For every MANIFEST row: census detail looked up (missing -> counted in no_detail and the row still emitted with empty detail), debtscan_flags DERIVED ('needs-consumer-trace' iff status == 'unreviewed'; 'orphan-candidate' iff the RESOLVED classification_reason lower-cased contains any of 'orphan' / 'superseded' / 'not invoked' / 'no event source', :89-91), four prose fields and four detail fields resolved manifest-wins-else-census (:86-88, :99-107). (4) resources_by_named_thread from the taxonomy's lambda_to_named_thread (191 lambdas -> 27 named threads, :113-119). (5) named_threads = the 25-name CATALOG_ORDER literal filtered to names present, then the sorted remainder of (manifest named_threads UNION taxonomy named_threads) (:130-136) -> 29 today. (6) last_review PRESERVED from the prior artifact at the OUTPUT path (:148-153), floor '2026-06-15' when none is readable; generated_at = now. (7) json.dump over the output path (full overwrite, indent 1) and six summary prints (:161-168). EXERCISED at carding: run with OPAL_RESOLVER_OUT pointed at scratch (the documented exercise mode, :24-28) -- rc 0, rows 135 / threads 135 / named 29 / no_detail 5 (sentiment_query_api, test-yfinance-simple, yfinance-aapl-test, ycharts-session, canonical-schwab), the summary lines reproduced verbatim.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: LOUD on missing or unparseable INPUTS: every open() and load is unguarded (:32, :58, :61, :113), so a missing manifest, census file or taxonomy, or malformed YAML/JSON, raises and the process exits non-zero WITHOUT touching the output -- and the only caller reads that rc and prints 'REFRESH FAILED ... snapshot NOT regenerated and left untouched' (opal_estate_infrastructure.py:475-481). SILENT on the three things that matter more: (a) a census-only thread is dropped with no count (coverage); (b) a prior artifact that is unreadable or corrupt at the output path is swallowed by the ONE handler in the file, `except (OSError, ValueError): pass` (:152-153), and last_review regresses to the 2026-06-15 floor with no message -- the exact 'moved the review vintage BACKWARDS' defect the :137-147 comment says this code was written to prevent, still reachable through a corrupt prior file; (c) the served artifact carries generated_at but NOTHING that says whether its inputs have changed since, so a stale-against-inputs resolver (2 of 135 today) is indistinguishable, from the artifact alone, from a fresh one -- the consumer ages last_review, which is a REVIEW clock, not an input-vintage clock.

verdict.why: The join does what its docstring says and nothing else: routing from the committed manifest, detail from the census with manifest-wins precedence, resources from the taxonomy, a full overwrite that carries exactly one field forward, and it fails LOUD on any missing or malformed input -- reproduced at carding on 133 of 135 threads byte-for-byte with named_threads and the resource map exact. The 'A REGEN IS NOT A REVIEW' fix at :137-153 is real and correct in direction. QUALIFIED on four measured points. FIRST, the served artifact is STALE AGAINST ITS OWN INPUTS TODAY: the census was edited @727daaab94 after the last regen @7fe3a68013, the declared on-change rebuild has no mechanism (one manual caller, comp-estate --refresh), and 2 of 135 served threads carry a truncated classification_reason as a result -- and no field on the artifact can say so. SECOND, the producer counts coverage in one direction only: manifest rows lacking census detail are printed (5), census thread_ids lacking a manifest row are dropped silently (17 of 147), so the number it prints is the smaller of the two gaps. THIRD, the one exception handler in the file (:152) is on the one path the :137-147 comment says must never regress -- a corrupt prior artifact resets last_review to the floor with no message. FOURTH, the source declares the census frozen (:47-48) and the census has since been edited by its authority, so the manifest-wins contract now sits on a moving default; the comment is false as of 2026-08-20. Beside these, generated_from is a literal naming pins the inputs no longer sit at (:156). None of these leak or corrupt routing; all of them make the served map quietly narrower or older than its consumers can tell.
